items.title: SK Hynix Q3 profit jumps sevenfold to record high, Nvidia supplier unveils $75 billion shareholder return plan
items.author: Reuters
items.highlights: South Korean chipmaker SK Hynix reported a more than seven-fold rise in quarterly operating profit to a record high on Wednesday, beating market forecasts, as continued demand for AI infrastructure drove up memory chip prices. The Nvidia supplier also said it will pursue shareholder returns totalling about 100 trillion won ($75.4 billion) this year, comprising cash dividends of 30 trillion won and share repurchases and cancellations of 60 trillion won, including 40 trillion won announced in August. items.title: SK hynix says DRAM, HBM booked through 2029 as profit soars to $62B
items.author: LEE JAE-LIM
items.highlights: SK hynix’s operating profit surged more than sevenfold on year to a record 83.33 trillion won ($62.23 billion) in the third quarter, helping settle fears of an AI investment bubble and a looming memory chip glut as the chipmaker said its dynamic random-access memory (DRAM) and high bandwidth memory (HBM) volumes are effectively sold out through 2029. ... The biggest takeaway from the earnings call was SK hynix's view of future demand — stretching into 2029, a year beyond the 2028 horizon that chipmakers had previously projected for the memory supply crunch. items.author: Stock Titan Editorial Team

items.author: Suh Jong-gap, Cho Yang-joon, Lee Seok-jin
items.highlights: Nvidia posted another record quarter as the leader in artificial intelligence chips, prompting analysts to raise their earnings expectations for Samsung Electronics and SK hynix. Expanding investment in AI data centers and a prolonged shortage of high-bandwidth memory (HBM) are expected to sustain profit gains at the South Korean memory makers for some time. items.highlights: 值得注意的是，HBM 并非唯一的增长引擎，服务器对高速内存及其他类型存储设备的综合需求共同支撑了业绩。在订单锁定方面，海力士已与 14 家主要客户签订长期协议，锁定的量相当于 2027 年和 2028 年总产能的半数以上。这些为期五年的合同价格在约定范围内反映市场情况，并非永久固定今日价格。产能规划上，公司计划在年底前提升 M15X 工厂产能以增加 HBM4 供应，并预计 HBM4 在第四季度的出货量和收入都将超过上一代 HBM3E，不过实际结果仍需后续财报验证。
